notes:
Summary: Murmuration operates a real-time personalization platform for live storefronts (ad placements + product recs). Very latency- and cost-sensitive; biggest win is shaving p99 response for short contexts and lowering per-token costs. Primary ask: dedicated predictable tail latency + Optimize advice for batching/caching/quantization.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "P99 < 50ms for 256-token seqs under 2000 qps is our target" — Head of Infra
- Need deterministic tail behavior during flash traffic (sales drops to <100ms spikes unacceptable)
- Must support VPC private control plane, SSO + audit logs, KMS integration, 90-day log retention for compliance
- Quantization: want to evaluate 8-bit and 4-bit flows for base LLM and a distilled reranker; accuracy regressions must be tracked vs baseline
- Batching & caching: interested in automatic batching but must be able to cap batch delay (<6ms additional latency). KV/prefix cache expected for repeated conversational context across requests

POC plan / success criteria:
- Redwood to run 3 perf scenarios during 2/15-2/18 window: (1) steady 2k qps 128-token baseline; (2) bursty 5k qps with 90/10 distribution short/long; (3) rerank pipeline combining embedding similarity + light reranker at 1k qps
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost per 1M tokens, quality regression delta (ROUGE/BLEU/CTR uplift for recs)
- Deliverable: perf report + Optimize config recommendations (batching policy, cache TTLs, recommended quantization profile, kernel hints)

Technical notes from SE call:
- Customer uses mixed model sizes: 7B distilled for chat + 70B reranker. Want option to route heavy traffic to smaller quantized variants during peak.
- Requests to include per-route SLOs + automatic fallback to a compatible model variant when dedicated pool saturated
- Interested in Redwood's rollout controls (canary/A-B) for model upgrades and rollback automation
